title: An Hour at the Library
author: 词迹编辑

rights.label: 词迹原创

difficultyNote: 使用常见词汇、简单过去时与短句，补充经典原文中较少的入门难度。未经标准化测评。
background: 一篇为入门阅读补充的原创小故事。林第一次尝试借英文书，发现选择适合自己的难度也是阅读的一部分。
backgroundEn: This original beginner story follows Lin’s first visit to the English shelves at a library. Choosing a suitable book is part of learning to read.

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Lin went to the town library. She wanted an English book, but she did not know where to start. There were long books, short books and books with pictures.
She opened a large novel. The first page had too many new words. She put it back and asked the librarian for help. He showed her a short story about a train journey.
Lin sat by the window and read the first page. She did not understand every word, but she understood the story. She wrote three new words in her notebook and kept reading.
An hour later, she was ready to go home. She borrowed the book and put it in her bag. It was not the biggest book on the shelf. It was a book she wanted to finish.
